title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nila fears staying home alone, while Chozhan buys her gold bangles. Meanwhile, Vannathi questions Pandian to confirm whether he spotted her at the theatre.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Mathi provokes Lakshmi to assign chores to Selvi and ensures she completes them. Later, everyone wishes Mathi well as she starts her new job at college, except Ragavan.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: After his release, Sethupathi thanks Tamizhselvi for standing by him and proving his innocence. He apologises to Karuppu for misunderstanding him and shares an emotional embrace.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Arjun warns Shyam for coming in his way, panicking Madhu. Aadhavan sneaks into Pooja's room, triggering a lizard scare while Pooja insists Aadhavan stay only after marriage.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu gives Kanmani a massage during the pregnancy workshop, helping her feel relieved. Kanmani is delighted to be selected to present her business idea at an expo.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Shanmugam and Abhi finally get married with Kandhasamy's consent following an emotional moment. Later, Abhi's parents break their ties with her over the secret wedding.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Sakthivel's insult angers Pandian's family, leaving them furious with him. Meanwhile, preparations secretly begin for Pandian and Gomathi's wedding anniversary celebration.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Rohini urges Meena to rest at Chandra's house. Doctor advises Shruthi against abortion, sparking a heated fight with Ravi while Meena and Rohini also urge her to keep the baby.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Karna and Divakar discuss his release while Shanmugam makes Abinaya eat  the sweet Vetri has got. Vetri shows care for Abinaya and panics when Sandhya recovers from a shock.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Sarasu puts up Muthaiyah's death anniversary posters near his rivals' homes. Mayandi wakes Azhagar early and assigns Gomathi and Chelladurai to teach him farming.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Kalamma warns Siddharth over bribing voters with drinks. Later, Ilamathi shares Paraman's campaign promises with village women while fearing defeat, Kalamma tricks Paraman.
